assumptions: Single-agent fallback used as requested; no sub-agents were spawned.
municipality_only includes municipal parts explicitly shown as part of Nové Město nad Metují, such as Krčín and Rezek.
chalupa was treated as an input-only house-like type, but listings explicitly titled or categorized as chata were excluded.
gaps: Portal-by-portal search was completed through the single-agent fallback, but local helper/direct-fetch commands could not use network DNS in this environment; web-index and available listing-page fetches were used instead.

realitymix.cz detail pages returned cache-miss through the fetch tool for some direct detail URLs, so the retained RealityMix land row relies on a search snapshot that exposed title, exact municipality, sale type, residential/buildable land use, price, land area, and detail URL.

Excluded notable non-retained candidates: iDNES Českých bratří bytový/nájemní house had price on request; iDNES runway/airfield land was not residential/buildable; MM Reality house listings found had land below 1000 m2; chata listings were excluded; garden listings below 1000 m2 were excluded.
